title: Design the authorization seam for pkix-ac
design:
Constraint-solver-shaped: the seam hands over attributes and predicates and gets back nothing it then has to trust.

What the host is given, to be settled in this bead rather than assumed:
  - attribute OIDs and their raw values, uninterpreted
  - the holder binding result, as a fact already established
  - the evaluation time

What the seam explicitly does NOT supply, which is the whole design:
  - no comparability assumption between attribute values
  - no lattice
  - no ordering

The last three are the temptation. A seam that supplies an ordering has decided that clearances are comparable, which is true for ESS/X.411 and false for TLP, and a host whose scheme has no subject-clearance concept cannot un-decide it.

Precedent in this workspace: pkix-ac::verify takes the authority's certificate and documents that the caller must have validated it, rather than taking trust anchors and deciding. Same shape -- hand over the fact, refuse the judgement.
acceptance_criteria:
[ ] The seam's inputs and non-inputs written down, with the reason each omission is deliberate
[ ] No API returns an authorization verdict
[ ] Documented against RFC 5755 4.4's six attribute types, naming which are passed through uninterpreted
[ ] A caller can evaluate a scheme with no ordering without fighting the types
